name: Marksman
theme: Apotheosis of the Headhunter. Every encounter opens with a guaranteed crit on a Marked head; Precision Payoffs detonate at +50%.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'First hit on any new target always crits. Precision payoffs deal +50% damage.'
Pairs with hunter.json marksman path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Headhunter + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~22 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Mark Hunter.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 7 of 8 wireable today (clean Mark palette + crit stat-sticks). First-hit-guaranteed-crit + precision-payoff bonus capstone needs Phase F (firstHitOnTarget condition + precision payoff hook).

nodes.name: Mark Tracker
nodes.description: +0.5/1.0/1.5s ailment duration (extends Mark/Tracked windows via the ailment-duration channel).

nodes.description: On crit, +5/10/15/20/25% chance to apply Mark to the target (cross-skill Mark applier).

nodes.name: Mark Hunter
nodes.description: +5/10/15% damage to Marked targets (foundation Mark-vulnerability scaler).

nodes.name: Sniper's Tempo
nodes.description: +5% crit chance (1-rank identity — foundation amplifier, pairs with the opener-crit fantasy).

nodes.name: Predator's Mark
nodes.description: +10/20/30% damage to Marked targets (deeper Marked-vulnerability — stacks with Mark Hunter).
